method: Read-only source inspection plus syntax checks; no browser, GitHub workflow or upload was executed by this review.

sourceChecks.detail: contents:read only; no repository/environment/deployment secret or provider credential configured.
Default verification still exits 2 for incomplete release. --expect-closed exits 0 only with valid identities, actual review denied, publicActivation false and all backend flags false.

Fresh browser contexts use an intercepted qa.zplay.invalid origin; outside origins abort, unknown fixture paths return 404, SPIN endpoint returns mock failure, and no request is continued to a live server.

Check failures throw, run marks success false, runner sets nonzero exit. Setup/import/close exceptions reach the top-level nonzero catch. Missing artifact output cannot yield a successful upload step.
Runner records exact source file SHA-256 values, git commit, fixture flag, screenshots hashes, browser version and explicit limitations. No runtime match or production fairness is inferred.
This workflow runs checked-out repository code. It does not retry the rejected private-source upload.

limits: This is a review of current source, not evidence that the workflow/browser run has executed or passed.
The current browser script exercises repeated body key events, not native held Enter on a focused SPIN/STOP/AUTO control.
Actual BFCache navigation/restoration is not tested by the current browser script.
Node handler regressions cover key default cancellation and persisted pagehide/pageshow routing, but native browser behavior still needs observation.
The fixture cannot verify a real ETB ledger, real probability model, server-side version retention, provider sound parity, physical-device behavior or 60 FPS.
Future changes adding network mechanisms beyond the inspected HTTP requests must be reviewed for isolation before claiming equivalent coverage.
